skills.name: get-zestimate
skills.description: Fetch the current Zestimate (Zillow's automated valuation) and rent Zestimate for a U.S. property by Zillow zpid.

skills.name: lookup-zillow-property
skills.description: Look up a U.S. property by address or Zillow zpid and return full property data including price, Zestimate, photos, schools, taxes, agent contact, and price history.

skills.name: search-zillow-listings
skills.description: Search U.S. property listings inside a geographic bounding box, filtered by status (for_sale, for_rent, sold), price ceiling, and bedroom count.

skills.name: verify-zillow-webhook
skills.description: Verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature on an inbound Zillapi webhook so you can trust the payload before acting on it.
